newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom gives ad account to Alice.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom gives ad account to Alice.

text.p: France Telecom said advertising agency Alice had been selected for the mass market advertising for the partial privatisation of the telecoms group, with a 75 million franc budget.
Six agencies had been shortlisted for the deal. They were Alice, BBDP, CLM, BBDO, Devarrieux Villaret, FCA and Young & Rubicam.
Euro RSCG, part of Havas, had already been charged with the financial communication while Altedia will handle the information campaign for France Telecom staff.
